the_organising_principle_2026_10_12.statement: The last several weeks of A/B work in this line were run at patience 3, which early-stops runs that are still improving. Any arm that happened to escape the early-stop window looks better than it is. This does not PROVE past A/B results are artifacts — it makes them uninterpretable until re-run.
the_organising_principle_2026_10_12.evidence: seed0 stopped at ep14 with 0.9194 while its last three epochs were 0.9031 / 0.8922 / 0.9144 (still oscillating up); seed1 stopped ep15 at 0.9297; seed2 escaped and ran to ep28 reaching 0.9703. Three-seed mean 0.9398 +/- 0.0269 is a convergence-TIME spread, not a noise floor.
the_organising_principle_2026_10_12.root_cause: DEFAULT_EARLY_STOP_PATIENCE = 3 at train_cfm_yuelbond_wasserstein.py:720, and no config sets it. bond_type_f1 routes through --early-stop-patience, NOT the legacy --patience (default 10) that governs decode_ratio.

blockers.title: No decode path integrates the ODE, so m4 QED / m5 SA / m7 diversity are UNMEASURED for free generation
blockers.what_it_actually_does: Loads REAL tmQM geometries (load_tmqm_clouds) and runs only the bond head — featurise, _select_bonds, _bridge_components, _assemble_mol. It never calls the sampler.
blockers.the_gap: The trainer's real generation path is evaluate_generation_validity -> generate_clouds_from_noise (train_cfm_yuelbond_wasserstein.py:4683). Nothing in the dump script reaches it.
blockers.consequence: Every SMILES in those CSVs is a BOND-HEAD RECONSTRUCTION OF A REAL CORPUS MOLECULE. QED 0.2209 / SA 4.974 / chemistry validity 100% / single_fragment 0.7838 all describe reconstruction, not generation.

independent_evidence.gap: +0.1365 — the output is as synthesisable as its input, because the geometry was supplied
independent_evidence.size_matched: real corpus at n=192 is 4.8781 — 1.5-2.8 SA BETTER at every heavy-atom bucket

blockers.fix: Add an ODE-integrating decode path that calls generate_clouds_from_noise and writes the same CSV schema, so cfm_property_panel.py can finally score free generation.
blockers.already_solved_by_the_trainer: evaluate_generation_validity already integrates and already has --save-generated-smiles; the flag is declared at ~:5629 and consumed at :9069/9095 but no config sets it. The cheapest fix may be a config that sets it, not new code.

blockers.title: gen_validity has no noise floor; per-epoch n varies from 48 to 768 across runs and the metric swings 0.0-1.0 on the small-n runs
blockers.finding: Taking max() over a run's gen_validity is meaningless when n is small. cfm_fm_ab_2026_10_09 evaluates n=48 per epoch and alternates between 0.6875 and 0.0625; cfm_bond_head_30ep_onecycle hits 0.0208 then exactly 0.0000 for six consecutive epochs.
blockers.consequence: Any 'this run reached gen_validity 1.0' claim drawn from an n=48 run is a sampling artefact. Runs are only comparable at the same n and solver.

At this run's own operating point (ep5, bond_ce 0.03936) the same 0.12 gives an entropy term 3.66x-4.36x the bond CE. The guard test reports against a THIRD denominator (train_loss). Three denominators, one number.

blockers.title: m4 QED 口径 — the definition fix is correct but its measured magnitude is provenance-lost
blockers.definition: CORRECT and verified. cfm_property_panel.py::build_panel filters n_frags==1 and reports single_fragment_rate as its denominator. Independently recomputed on the per_molecule rows: mean matches the aggregate exactly (0.11392229108218548, n=21).
blockers.problem: The 5-run magnitude table in cfm_qed_fragment_aware.json has NO CSV behind it — cfm_frag_control / cfm_frag_assemble / cfm_fm_ab_* / cfm_fm_control_* / cfm_blk_c5_repair_* have no generated_smiles.csv and never did in git history. Treat as provenance-lost, not evidence.
blockers.sign_conflict: The 4 CSVs that DO exist (written today by BLK-C-M2's script) show +3.7%..+8.5%, the opposite sign to the lost table's -34%..-36%.
blockers.why_the_sign_flips: Two effects compete: mixing fragments into whole-SMILES QED lowers it, but restricting to single fragments also changes the population (connected molecules are larger, and QED penalises small ones). On a high-connectivity cohort the second wins; on a heavily-fragmenting generation cohort the first wins.
blockers.blocked_by: BLK-C-M2 — these rows are reconstructions, so they cannot be compared with the free-generation rows

blockers.title: cross-application to the NCI-60 classifiers scored reconstructions, not generated molecules
blockers.second_problem: n_generated = 37 is far too small for a per-cell-line mean over 5 seeds, independent of the provenance issue
blockers.what_survives: The per-cell SPREAD is real and is a BOND-PERCEPTION result: A549 0.8335 / A2780cis 0.8065 vs A2780 0.4010 and HCT116 0.4314 is the bond head reproducing cis-vs-trans geometry distinctions on KNOWN molecules.
blockers.what_does_not_survive: Any reading about what the generator produces. gen_validity for FREE generation is 0.23-0.38; this cohort is seeded-geometry reconstruction.
blockers.honesty_check_still_owed: a metal complex scored by a classifier trained mostly on organic compounds is an out-of-distribution question. Check whether metal-containing compounds are in the NCI-60 training distribution at all before saying anything about activity.
